candidate.claim: unifiedDiff does not handle append-only changes: when before is a prefix of after, start is -1 with different lengths so it does not return early and then indexes beforeLines[-1]/afterLines[-1] producing undefined diff lines.
candidate.title: unifiedDiff emits undefined lines for prefix append

verifier.reason: Confirmed at patch/index.mjs:152-159: when beforeLines is a line-prefix of afterLines findIndex returns -1, the equality guard at patch/index.mjs:153 does not return because lengths differ, the suffix loop cannot remove the -1 start, and both output loops begin at index -1, pushing '-'+beforeLines[-1] and '+'+afterLines[-1] i.e. '-undefined'/'+undefined'.
